title: Error Prevention: Firecrawl API Key Required Error
description: Specification for preventing and handling: FirecrawlApp constructor throws error when no API key is provided, causing scraper initialization to fail.

requirements.title: Prevention Measures
requirements.description: Implement prevention steps to avoid this error

acceptanceCriteria.description: Always provide fallback mechanisms for optional integrations
Test integrations with and without API keys
Use proper TypeScript null handling for optional dependencies

requirements.title: Error Detection
requirements.description: Implement detection mechanisms for this error type

acceptanceCriteria.description: Error is logged with proper context

requirements.title: Error Resolution
requirements.description: Implement resolution procedures for this error

implementation.solution: Modified CatalogScraper constructor to handle null API key gracefully by setting firecrawl to null and using fallback scraping method. Updated type definitions and scraping logic to handle null firecrawl instance.
